notes: New: the Mirage Layout Maker. Open it from Settings, Portal loader tab, beside the loader studio.

Two steps. First you arrange: the strip is nine columns across and three rows deep, twenty-seven cells, and you drag across any block of them and group it into a card. One cell is a card; so is three wide by one high.

Then you fill: pick a card and choose what goes in it. The list only offers what will actually work at that shape -- a rune that refuses a long thin card says so, and the ones still being finished are shown as pending rather than hidden.
Finish and it copies the whole layout out, cards, shapes and real pixel sizes.
